svg.title: Dental Clinic Management System Data Flow Diagram Level 1
svg.desc: Nine independent horizontal data-flow lanes connect external actors to application processes and their data stores without crossing lines.
svg.text: Independent process lanes make the actors, records and data stores easy to trace

g.text: Authenticate · validate role access · scan ID and compare face
Store protected identity data only with required consent
Possible duplicate face matches go to clinic review
Manage dentist, service, date, time and status
Maintain tooth conditions and treatment details
Link care to patient, dentist and appointment
Calculate invoice total, confirmed paid and balance
Review manual payments or process optional checkout
Maintain public service catalog and pricing
Track stock quantities and low-stock threshold
Validate and store the sender's message and email
Admin drafts a reply; delivery needs configured SMTP
A reply is marked sent only after email backend accepts
Apply local rules to symptoms and common questions
Estimate cost from service, complexity and tooth count
Informational support only; not a clinical diagnosis
treatments, top services and patient growth
Read-only reporting; does not create clinic records
Record successful / failed sign-ins and sign-outs
Capture selected admin, appointment and billing changes
D5 reuses Service / Inventory / Review; D7 is the audit store. Reporting reads operational stores.
